claim: Serre de la Madone is open April 1 to October 31 daily 10am-6pm except Mondays, with adult self-guided admission at €10 and €7 for ages 6-18, while guided tours cost €15 / €11 and require advance booking.
quote: 10€ Adults over 18 years of age... Self-guided tour... Guided tour... Adults €15 / Children (6-18) €11

claim: Serre de la Madone sits at 74 route du Val de Gorbio, a few kilometres inland from the coast with a bus stop within 500m, making it reachable but not walkable from Menton centre.
quote: 74 route du Val de Gorbio, 06500 Menton... a few kilometres from the coast... Near public transportation with bus stop within 500 meters

claim: Val Rahmeh-Menton botanical garden is run by the Muséum national d'Histoire naturelle (MNHN), open April-October 10am-6pm closed Tuesdays plus closed May 1, on roughly 1.5 hectares with about 1,800 subtropical and Mediterranean species.
quote: From April 1 to October 31: 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. Open every day except Tuesdays, May 1, and December 25... 1,800 subtropical, tropical and Mediterranean species

claim: Val Rahmeh was entrusted to the MNHN in 1967 and operates as a public botanical garden at Avenue Saint-Jacques on the Garavan side of Menton.
quote: entrusted to the MNHN (Muséum national d'Histoire naturelle) since 1967

claim: Jardin Maria Serena is accessible only by guided tour booked via Menton's Office de Tourisme, with mandatory reservation, adult ticket €10, reduced €7, children under 6 free, meeting in front of the main gate.
quote: Full price: €10.00... Children 6+ and students: €7.00... Under 6: Free... Devant le grand portail du jardin

claim: Maria Serena's guided tours typically run Tuesdays, Thursdays and Saturdays 10:00-11:30 from a villa designed by Charles Garnier, reputed to be the most temperate garden in France with palms, cycads and tropical species.
quote: Tuesdays, Thursdays, and Saturdays from 10:00 to 11:30... reputed to be the most temperate in France... villa Maria Serena was built in 1886 on the plans of Charles Garnier

claim: Fontana Rosa requires a booked guided tour through the Office de Tourisme at €6 per person, meeting at 6 Avenue Blasco-Ibañez; bookings handled by phone +33 4 92 41 76 76.
quote: The guided tour costs €6.00 for all audiences... Reservations are mandatory... Entrée du jardin... 6 Avenue Blasco-Ibañez, 06500 Menton

claim: Fontana Rosa, created by Spanish novelist Vicente Blasco-Ibañez in 1921 and classified Monument Historique in 1990, is a Valencian-style ceramic 'jardin des Romanciers' under ongoing restoration by the city.
quote: créé en 1921 par Vicente Blasco-Ibañez... classé Monument Historique depuis 1990... jardin des Romanciers

claim: Jardin des Colombières, the private Ferdinand Bac villa-garden at 312 Route de Super Garavan, opens to guided visits each Wednesday at 2pm (9am in July-August) from April to October, €20 per person, capped at 15 visitors, online booking only.
quote: Wednesdays at 2:00 PM (9:00 AM in July-August), April through October... €20 per person... 15 people per visit... 312 Route de Super Garavan

claim: Les Colombières paths are steep, uneven and unsuitable for young children or visitors with mobility issues, with the upper entrance the only meeting point and pets not allowed.
quote: garden paths are often steep and uneven... not recommended for young children and anyone with mobility problems... Upper entrance only

claim: Clos du Peyronnet (Waterfield Garden) only opens for public guided tours on Fridays of September and October at 3pm, at €20 per adult and €14 reduced, capped at 20 guests — meaning it is NOT visitable in May 2026.
quote: each Friday of September and October at 3pm with a certified guide in English and French... 20€ per adult, or 14€ per student or child... maximum of 20 guests

claim: Clos du Peyronnet has been owned by the Waterfield family for more than a century and is regarded as the best surviving English-style Arts and Crafts garden on the French Riviera.
quote: the property has been owned and developed by super-plantsman William Waterfield and his family for more than a century

claim: Menton's six historic gardens — Maria Serena, Serre de la Madone, Fontana Rosa, Clos du Peyronnet, Val Rahmeh and Les Colombières — are collectively promoted by the Office de Tourisme as the city's 'Jardins Remarquables' circuit.
quote: Maria Serena, Serre de la Madone, Fontana Rosa, Clos du Peyronet, Val Rahmeh-Menton Botanical Garden and Les Colombières Garden are almost all open to the general public
